description: A battalion executive officer must finalize the receiving, cold-storage, release, and power-continuity plan for a temperature-controlled medical supply shipment arriving at the support compound.

shared_context.S1: A temperature-controlled medical supply shipment is scheduled to arrive at the support compound on Friday.
shared_context.S2: The cold room has two storage bays, Bay A and Bay B, and each bay can hold six pallets.
shared_context.S3: Incoming refrigerated loads normally use Bay A and are received during the standard 0800-1200 Friday window.
shared_context.S4: The battalion executive officer signs the final receiving and storage plan.
shared_context.S5: The standing weekly sustainment huddle is used to confirm changes to shipment, clinic, and facility plans before the receiving schedule is signed.

PF1.text: Capt. Morgan received the supplier's confirmed shipping notice this morning: the load is exactly four pallets and the carrier's appointment is exactly 1030-1130 Friday. The notice has not yet been entered on the battalion receiving tracker.

PF2.text: SFC Patel confirmed that two pallet spaces in Bay B must remain reserved for the clinic's Monday immunization issue and cannot be released until exactly 0600 Monday. This requirement is recorded in the clinic supply worksheet but has not been cross-referenced with the battalion storage plan.

PF3.text: WO1 Brooks confirmed that Bay A is scheduled for defrost and sanitation from exactly 0900-1200 Friday, making it unavailable during the carrier appointment. The cold-room backup generator also requires a documented power-continuity check before the shipment is stored; the facilities work ticket has not yet been attached to the receiving packet.

acceptance_conditions: The shipment must be recorded as exactly four pallets.
Receiving must be scheduled for exactly 1030-1130 Friday.
The shipment must be stored in Bay B.
Exactly two pallet spaces in Bay B must remain reserved for the clinic.
The clinic reserve must remain unavailable until exactly 0600 Monday.
A documented cold-room backup-power continuity check must be committed.
The Bay A outage must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'WO1 Brooks' and ('power-continuity check' in c['detail'] or 'backup generator' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The supplier notice changes the recorded shipment quantity to exactly four pallets and the receiving window to exactly 1030-1130 Friday.
The clinic worksheet changes the Bay B reserve to exactly two pallet spaces and fixes their release at exactly 0600 Monday.
The facilities ticket makes Bay A unavailable during the appointment, requiring Bay B storage, and adds the required cold-room backup-power continuity check and its citation.
